name: cretan-cat
description: Manousos, a pixel-art Cretan cat above the prompt, or Asturias, his Argentine ginger sister. Clawd tells the cat what to do while Claude works; Manousos answers in mantinades, Asturias in coplas and tangos, when she isn't slapping him.

language.title: Cretan cat: language
language.description: What Clawd says to the cat, and the cat's short replies. Manousos' mantinades are always in Greek; Asturias sings and answers in Argentine Spanish whatever this says.

sound.title: Cretan cat: sound
sound.description: A soft meow when the work is done or Claude is waiting for you. Plays on macOS only.
